LanguageData.LP_Githyanki.label: githyanki
LanguageData.LP_Githyanki.description: Descendants of a race once enslaved by mind flayers; the bloodline is passed on to children. Githyanki are gaunt and pointy-eared, with sickly grey-yellow-green skin; naturally psychically sensitive, excellent swordsmen, able to teleport short distances through the Astral Plane. They have been enemies of mind flayers for generations and strike them especially hard, and tadpoles struggle to take root in their brains. Githyanki worship the undying lich-queen, revere liches, and are more easily swayed when a lich tries to recruit them. They are arrogant, belligerent and poor at socializing.
LanguageData.LP_Githyanki.descriptionShort: Inheritable psionic swordsman race. Psychically sensitive, strong melee, astral jump; sworn enemies of mind flayers, revere liches; belligerent, poor socializers.
